Meta.title: LumiClaw Presence | Campaign walking skeleton
Meta.description: Plan, review, and improve market-specific content from one clear objective.

Shell.journeyLabel: Five steps from objective to improvement
Shell.footer: This is a safe preview: no real account is connected and nothing can be approved or published.

campaigns.title: Start with one clear campaign objective.
campaigns.summary: This is where you will explain what you are promoting, who it is for, and what you want people to do. Content and review will stay anchored to that objective.
campaigns.status: You can create, save, and reopen a demo campaign
campaigns.basis: Data is stored in local PostgreSQL; everything remains public-safe demo seed with no real account.
campaigns.next: Set the objective and call to action, then create the first demo campaign.
campaigns.previewTitle: When ready, this area will summarize

previewItems.first: The outcome you want this campaign to achieve
previewItems.third: The next item that needs your attention

campaigns.technicalBasis: REST, OpenAPI, Idempotency-Key, ETag, and version snapshots share one PostgreSQL control plane.

setup.title: Get the facts ready before writing content.
setup.summary: Your brand story, product value, target market, and supporting proof will live together here so every platform starts from the same truth.
setup.status: The minimal brand, product, market, and evidence matrix can be saved
setup.basis: Only synthetic material is used; draft facts remain visibly owner-blocked instead of being treated as approved.
setup.next: Review the brand matrix and supporting evidence while keeping the demo public-safe.

previewItems.second: Facts and proof that may be used publicly

setup.technicalBasis: Organization, Identity, Brand, Product, Market, ChannelAccount, AccountMandate, and Claim–Evidence now enforce tenant scope.

mission.title: Give every task an owner and every conclusion evidence.
mission.summary: Six specialists separately verify facts, plan, write for four platforms, and independently check the work. The coordinator assigns work but produces none of it.
mission.status: All progress, content versions, and checks come from one durable source
mission.basis: This is a safe rehearsal only. Demo results and real collaboration evidence are labeled separately and never imply publication.
mission.next: Start a safe rehearsal from the exact saved version and inspect six responsibilities and dependencies.
mission.previewTitle: Four platform-specific content versions will appear here

previewItems.first: A suitable expression for each platform
previewItems.second: Content you can edit before review
previewItems.third: A preview before handoff or publication

mission.technicalBasis: Project/DAG/ACK/Submit, RoleContext, SkillLock, digest/schema validation, timeout/recovery, and PostgreSQL state have repeatable engineering verification.

review.title: See why one claim was denied, then review the exact correction.
review.summary: An independent checker compares every version with confirmed facts, supporting proof, account responsibility, and platform limits. A correction automatically invalidates the old check.
review.status: The faulty statement was denied; four corrected platform versions need your exact confirmation
review.basis: Your confirmation is explicitly non-executable: it connects no account, triggers no schedule, and performs no external action.
review.next: Compare at most two versions, inspect cited proof and the next responsible person, then confirm the exact version.
review.previewTitle: A real review will bring together

previewItems.first: The exact content proposed for sharing
previewItems.second: The facts that support each statement
previewItems.third: Risk notes and decisions that need you

review.technicalBasis: Immutable four-platform Revisions, FAIL→correction→re-audit, Audit invalidation, and non-executable Owner Review share one control plane. M3 execution remains unimplemented.

learn.title: See what people actually did, then decide what to change.
learn.summary: Comments, interactions, and outcomes will be organized into traceable feedback and suggestions. The system will never rewrite your approved brand facts on its own.
learn.status: Explicitly blocked: there is no real platform feedback
learn.basis: No platform account is connected and no customer, comment, or interaction data has been imported.
learn.next: Confirm that real feedback, system suggestions, and your final decision are clearly separated.
learn.previewTitle: When ready, this area will organize
learn.technicalBasis: Interaction, Outcome, Disposition, and LearningProposal are not implemented or persisted.

Mission.disclaimer: This is an illustration; you will still confirm before anything is shared.

ActivationEvidence.title: Go publish
ActivationEvidence.summary: After you approve the exact revision, use one desktop assistant to carry the approved copy and ordered media into the intended platform account.
ActivationEvidence.safety: This isolated evidence surface never navigates, prefills a page, uploads media, clicks publish, or claims a post succeeded.
ActivationEvidence.platformList: The same manual flow, with truthful platform limits

actions.copyTextNote: Copy only the exact approved revision.
actions.copyMediaNote: Keep the approved order across {count} media item(s).
actions.openPageNote: No copy, link, or media is placed into the page.
actions.manualCompleteNote: Confirm the visible account yourself; this is not a success receipt.

ActivationEvidence.awaiting: After manual completion: awaiting system reconciliation; publication remains unconfirmed.
ActivationEvidence.unknown: Unknown external result: reconcile first. The system will not resend.
ActivationEvidence.plannedReconciliation: Scheduled read-only account sync and exact Revision matching remain PLANNED and are not implemented in this slice.
ActivationEvidence.fixtureNote: Public-safe Storybook evidence · desktop browser only · no real account, secret, result return, or external action.

KnowledgeOnboarding.recoverBody: Your local name is saved. Add the remaining material step by step; each save creates a version you can return to after refresh or restart.
KnowledgeOnboarding.ownerTitle: First, tell us what to call you.
KnowledgeOnboarding.ownerBody: First open asks only for a local display name. No email, account registration, or technical metadata is required.
KnowledgeOnboarding.displayNameHint: Used only in this local workspace and editable later.
KnowledgeOnboarding.personaTitle: Define the founder or personal voice.
KnowledgeOnboarding.personaBody: Turn the role, viewpoints, and expression boundaries into human-reviewable rules.
KnowledgeOnboarding.organizationTitle: Record known brand and product facts.
KnowledgeOnboarding.organizationBody: These become traceable structured facts. Conflicting values are never silently overwritten.
KnowledgeOnboarding.claimsLater: The first version never lets a model approve claims. Approved claims and evidence must enter authoritative knowledge together.
KnowledgeOnboarding.sourceTitle: Add several sources without learning knowledge schemas.
KnowledgeOnboarding.sourceBody: After MD/TXT upload or pasted text, the system preserves the original Blob digest and immutable revision, then carries a source excerpt into final confirmation.
KnowledgeOnboarding.sourceTypes: 2 MB per file; PDF, DOCX, and audio remain planned
KnowledgeOnboarding.freeTextBody: For interview notes, brand context, or product facts. No KnowledgeItem, JSON, or digest fields are required.
KnowledgeOnboarding.accountBody: Only non-secret operating constraints are stored. The two platforms may use different markets, languages, audiences, and voices.
KnowledgeOnboarding.accountExists: I confirm this account actually exists
KnowledgeOnboarding.accountExistsHint: If unchecked, it is saved as not yet existing. The product never attempts login or connection.
KnowledgeOnboarding.noCredentialFields: There are no password, Cookie, OAuth, API key, or account-connection fields here.
KnowledgeOnboarding.contextTitle: Set operating defaults, then review each item.
KnowledgeOnboarding.contextBody: Market, Content Locale, and IANA Time Zone here are defaults for later work. They never overwrite the X or Xiaohongshu account profiles.
KnowledgeOnboarding.contextIndependent: UI locale, default content locale, default market, and time zone are separate concepts. Platform market and locale remain independently stored.
KnowledgeOnboarding.reviewTitle: Confirm sources, facts, conflicts, and gaps.
KnowledgeOnboarding.reviewBody: An immutable authoritative snapshot is created only when required material is available, conflicts are resolved, and you confirm the exact digest.

gaps.TIME_ZONE_REQUIRED: Set a default IANA time zone
gaps.SOURCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED: An older source needs Owner confirmation
gaps.SOURCE_BLOB_MISSING: Original source content is missing; approval is closed

KnowledgeOnboarding.sourceExcerptsBody: This stage does not pretend to extract reliable facts automatically. Approving the snapshot confirms these deterministic excerpts for later RoleContext use.
KnowledgeOnboarding.approvalNotice: Approval applies only to the exact sha256 above. Any source, profile, conflict decision, or default-context change creates a new version and closes the old approval path.
KnowledgeOnboarding.conflictTitle: These facts cannot both be true
KnowledgeOnboarding.authorityOrder: Candidates follow the frozen authority order, but the product never chooses for you: explicit Campaign decision > approved private organization knowledge > public market material > model suggestion awaiting confirmation.
KnowledgeOnboarding.approvedTitle: The authoritative knowledge snapshot is approved.
KnowledgeOnboarding.approvedBody: This immutable snapshot can be read by exact digest. This stage starts no Agent, compiles no Goal, and creates no platform content.
KnowledgeOnboarding.nextTitle: The next step belongs to SDD-009
KnowledgeOnboarding.nextBody: Goal expression and Mission compilation are not implemented by this module.
KnowledgeOnboarding.reviseBody: Returning starts a new draft and immediately stops treating the old snapshot as current. Approved history remains immutable and is never overwritten.

Production.desktopBody: The production workspace currently supports widths of 1024px and above. Mobile operations are deliberately excluded so review and publishing controls are not compressed into an unsafe interface.
Production.errorTitle: The local control plane is unavailable
Production.firstOpenEyebrow: LOCAL FIRST OPEN · this device only
Production.firstOpenTitle: First, tell us what to call you.
Production.firstOpenBody: Enter only a local display name, then choose the public example or your own local material. There is no email, password, or remote registration.
Production.noExternalActions: First-time setup performs no external publishing
Production.localIntroTitle: A governed public presence starts locally.
Production.localIntroBody: Identity, material, context, review, and every handoff remain visible and recoverable.
Production.displayNameHint: Stored in local PostgreSQL and visible later in Settings.
Production.firstOpenPathHint: Both choices first create the display name locally; the public example connects no external account.
Production.choiceTitle: Explore with an example, or bring real local material.
Production.choiceBody: Both paths enter the same Organization / Campaign source of truth, with material provenance kept explicit.
Production.exampleBody: Load a LumiClaw example organization, product, four-platform content, and metrics. No external account is connected.
Production.localBody: MD/TXT is parsed server-side, digest-verified, and saved locally. The content never becomes public evidence.
Production.materialBody: UTF-8 .md and .txt files are currently supported, up to 2 MiB each.
Production.materialPlanned: PDF, DOCX: PLANNED · parser, license, and security review incomplete
Production.contextTitle: Choose the workspace market and content scope
Production.contextBody: Target markets, content locales, and preferred platforms support multiple selections. The default schedule time zone is stored separately and never inferred from UI language or market.
Production.multiSelectHint: Choose one or more; at least one must remain
Production.contextScopeNote: Every selection is stored as workspace scope. The first Campaign includes all target markets; the current content contract uses the first selected locale for its initial review drafts and still prepares four safe review versions. Preferred platforms do not mean accounts are connected.
Production.identityTitle: Confirm your Organization, Brand, Product, and Campaign
Production.identityBody: The product does not guess company truth from a file. Compare the extracted text above and confirm these structured fields; saving creates your own LOCAL_PRIVATE Campaign.
Production.productDescriptionPlaceholder: A product description confirmed from the material
Production.campaignObjectivePlaceholder: What the target audience should understand
Production.callToActionPlaceholder: The next step readers should take
Production.finishSetup: Create my Campaign and enter workspace
Production.todayBody: Every task from facts to manual publishing identifies its source, owner, and blocking reason.
Production.campaignBody: One Campaign brings together the objective, market, platform expression, review, schedule, and handoff state.
Production.teamBody: Six clearly scoped AI employees collaborate from fact verification through independent audit.
Production.calendarBody: Only persistent PostgreSQL schedules appear here; no occurrence means no implied execution.
Production.publishBody: Review the content package, target platform, and account first. When approvals are complete, the desktop assistant guides a manual handoff to the official page.
Production.feedbackBody: Without official read-back or owner-imported evidence, the product makes no interaction, growth, lead, or revenue conclusions.
Production.knowledgeBody: Inspect the digest, extraction state, and source for public-safe example or local private material.
Production.accountsBody: OAuth, live connectors, and read-back are absent; unavailable capabilities stay disabled with remediation.
Production.settingsBody: Inspect local identity, four context fields, and the safe readiness contract for every service.
Production.auditTask: Independent audit is waiting for the SDD-007 runtime boundary
Production.handoffTask: Publishing authorization is blocked; {count} historical handoff receipts exist
Production.activeResponsibilityBody: The active responsibility is visible, but no runtime turn is claimed. The global roster contains {count} stable members.
Production.calendarEmptyBody: A later scheduling flow creates and reviews exact occurrence state; host cron and invented calendar events are not used here.
Production.exampleFixtureBody: This workspace uses the built-in public-safe Organization and Campaign fixture.
Production.localMaterialBody: These local materials belong only to this LOCAL_PRIVATE workspace and do not become public evidence.
Production.campaignUnavailableBody: Return to local onboarding or restore project-scoped PostgreSQL. The UI never substitutes in-memory success for the real control plane.
Production.auditResponsibilityBody: There is no AgentTeams runtime observation. This shows the independent-audit responsibility boundary, not a fabricated running state.
Production.reviewBlockedBody: The independent-audit runtime is not configured. Revisions can be inspected in full, but approval stays blocked until an auditable Mission exists.
Production.approvalBlocked: Approval blocked: no independent runtime audit receipt.
Production.artifactSourceRole: Artifact source role · runtime status NOT_CONFIGURED
Production.traceEvidenceBody: The contract exists; there is no current runtime observation.
Production.traceAuditBody: Blocked until the AgentTeams runtime is configured and returns an exact audit receipt.
Production.reviewExportLabel: Review only · not approval or a publishing handoff
Production.reviewExportOnly: Copy and download do not create a publishing handoff, approval state, or external action.
Production.reviewCopyComplete: Review draft copied; no publishing handoff was created.
Production.reviewDownloadComplete: Review media downloaded; no publishing handoff was created.
Production.publishAuthorizationBody: There is no authoritative independent Audit PASS and no external-action OwnerDecision bound to this exact Revision. NON_EXECUTABLE_OWNER_REVIEW cannot substitute for publishing approval.
Production.requiredAuthorities: Both authorities are required before publishing
Production.noAuthorizedHandoffReceipt: There is no authorized publishing handoff receipt.
Production.manualOnlyLabel: Not a business result · manual handoff only
Production.officialDestination: Official destination: {url} · verify the signed-in account yourself.
Production.manualStep1: Copy the exact body or download the current media.
Production.manualStep3: Verify the active account and complete content.
Production.manualStep4: Complete it manually; reconciliation remains pending.
Production.awaitingBody: Opening a page or self-reporting completion is not publication evidence; the state waits for reconciliation while read-back is absent.
Production.teamOverviewBody: Six responsibilities and their Skills are configured. Persistent runtime is absent, so every operating metric remains unobserved.
Production.teamMetricNote: 0 means there is no authoritative runtime observation, not zero business work.
Production.skillAvailabilityBody: This lists repository-owned Skills and static role bindings only; Skill availability is not presented as a running Agent.
Production.noScheduledTasks: There are no persistent scheduled tasks
Production.noScheduledTasksBody: SDD-007 has not provided mission-worker dispatch or persistent AgentTeams runtime. This view creates neither fake tasks nor in-memory timers.

A0.name: Mission coordination
A0.responsibility: Orchestrates tasks and dependencies without producing domain artifacts.

A1.name: Evidence stewardship
A1.responsibility: Freezes approved Claim and Evidence bindings.

A2.name: Market planning
A2.responsibility: Allocates market, account, and platform activation units.

GoalMission.knowledgeRequiredTitle: Approve an authoritative knowledge snapshot first
GoalMission.knowledgeRequiredBody: Continuous goals can read only approved, immutable persona, knowledge, and account profiles. Drafts never enter the compiler.
GoalMission.title: Turn a goal into a reviewable, recoverable operating rhythm.
GoalMission.body: Move from a 7/30-day Goal to a versioned content plan and a Mission contract covering only selected accounts. Every generation shows exact inputs, digests, and invalidation reasons.
GoalMission.truthBody: No model call, AgentTeams run, finished artifact, or external action occurs here.
GoalMission.saving: Writing to the authoritative control plane…
GoalMission.objectiveDefault: Explain product progress on a consistent, reviewable rhythm and learn whether the X and Xiaohongshu account voices remain clear and coherent.
GoalMission.cadenceSignal: Record whether planned slots reach Owner review on the intended rhythm.
GoalMission.voiceSignal: Record whether expression boundaries remain distinct across accounts.
GoalMission.ownerSignal: Record exact revisions approved or returned; this is not a business outcome.
GoalMission.goalDefinitionTitle: Define what this operating window should accomplish
GoalMission.ownerBoundary: Every mutation in this SDD is bound to the current local Owner.
GoalMission.independentCodes: UI locale, content locale, target market, and time zone are stored separately and never inferred from one another.
GoalMission.selectedAccounts: Accounts explicitly selected for this Mission
GoalMission.notBusinessOutcome: These are process signals—not growth, leads, revenue, or verified business outcomes.
GoalMission.activateRevision: Review and activate this Goal revision
GoalMission.compileIntentTitle: Freeze approved inputs and generate MissionIntent
GoalMission.compileIntentBody: The compiler reads only the approved snapshot and selected AccountOperatingProfile revisions. Insufficient coverage fails explicitly.
GoalMission.intentTitle: Inspect inputs and responsibilities before planning
GoalMission.intentBody: This generation fixes six roles, the Planner schema, Skill digests, and selected-platform tasks. No Agent has run.
GoalMission.responsibilityLeader: Coordinates acknowledgements, dependencies, and escalation without authoring domain content.
GoalMission.responsibilitySteward: Freezes approved claim, evidence, and source bindings.
GoalMission.responsibilityPlanner: Creates the bounded 7/30-day plan and current content brief.
GoalMission.responsibilityFounder: Completes assigned-account work under the founder-perspective mandate.
GoalMission.responsibilityProduct: Completes assigned-account work under the product-expertise mandate.
GoalMission.responsibilityAuditor: Independently audits both Producers against frozen bindings.
GoalMission.inputBindings: Inspect immutable input bindings and versions
GoalMission.fixtureBody: Use a schema-valid public-safe fixture to exercise the review contract. Role, input, schema, and Skill digests are still validated.
GoalMission.fixtureWarning: This is not an AgentTeams run or evidence of a Planner business result.
GoalMission.planTitle: Review and create a new Plan revision
GoalMission.planBody: Select a slot and adjust its theme or content objective. Save appends a revision; previous revisions are never overwritten.
GoalMission.executionBody: Generated only after approval of the exact Plan digest. Producers receive substantively different tasks and the Leader only orchestrates. Artifacts, Audit, and external actions remain out of scope.
GoalMission.invalidatedBody: Reason: {reason}. The system never silently recompiles; review inputs and explicitly create a new generation.
GoalMission.recoveryNoticeTitle: The prior generation is preserved and stopped
GoalMission.recoveryNoticeBody: Review and activate the latest Goal revision, then explicitly compile a new Mission generation. History is never overwritten.
GoalMission.recoveryAction: Review inputs and compile a new planning generation
GoalMission.noArtifactsActions: There is no Artifact, independent Audit result, ActionGrant, publishing, or Connector action here.
GoalMission.generationTrace: Generation, input digest, and invalidation trace
GoalMission.taskLeader: Coordinate dependencies and escalation without authoring domain output.
GoalMission.taskSteward: Freeze approved claim, evidence, and source bindings.
GoalMission.taskFounder: Produce founder-perspective content for exact assigned slots.
GoalMission.taskProduct: Produce product-expertise content for exact assigned slots.
GoalMission.taskAuditor: Audit both Producer outputs independently without editing or approving.
GoalMission.fixtureFounderObjective: Explain one public-safe founder decision in first person.
GoalMission.fixtureProductObjective: Explain one verifiable product workflow without business-outcome claims.
GoalMission.constraintNoAgentTeams: Do not claim that AgentTeams has run
GoalMission.constraintNoOutcome: Do not promise growth, leads, or revenue
GoalMission.constraintApprovedOnly: Use only approved immutable knowledge items
GoalMission.traceIntentDetail: The approved Snapshot, active Goal, and explicitly selected account revisions matched.
GoalMission.tracePlanDetail: Owner approval created a new immutable APPROVED Plan revision.
GoalMission.traceDagDetail: Tasks were materialized only for explicitly selected X/Xiaohongshu accounts.
GoalMission.producerCoverageError: Selected accounts do not cover both Founder Voice and Product Expertise. Add a mandate or select another approved account; the Leader will not fill in.
GoalMission.staleKnowledgeError: Approved knowledge has changed. Refresh and create a Goal revision against the current approved snapshot.
GoalMission.accountMissingError: A selected account is not an immutable revision in the approved snapshot. Review the account profile again.
GoalMission.concurrentError: Another window already wrote a new revision. Refresh and retry against the latest digest.
GoalMission.staleInputError: Goal, Plan, Snapshot, or account inputs changed. The old generation remains traceable but cannot continue.
GoalMission.genericError: The request did not pass the closed contract. Refresh for current state or repair input using the stable code.
